sacraments.text: Published rites 4 October and 1 November 2026 at 13:30; preparation 13 September via Zoom and 27 September in St Joseph AVA Room, both 13:30. Registration deadline 15 August has passed. Submit form/supporting documents to Secretary; ask office about next available preparation.
New journey normally begins two months after Easter. English and Chinese registration forms linked.
At least 12 months notice. Confirm a priest first, then email desired church booking dates. At least one party must be Catholic and a parishioner residing in Choa Chu Kang or Bukit Panjang.
Contact priest or office before hospital admission to arrange anointing.
Confirmation enquiries to Faith Formation; baptism extract application form submitted to Secretary.
